title: Dealing with the Order of the Night Wind Assassin
description: Returning to the palace from Mos Espa, Fennec Shand has the sole remaining member of the Order of the Night Wind in tow. In the throne room the assassin comes face to face with Boba Fett, who demands to know who sent him. As a member of the Order of the Night Wind, he fears no man and as such, refuses to talk, other than to bark insults. However, when Fennec drops him into the rancor pit, his fear overcomes his vow, and he reveals his employer, the mayor of Mos Espa.
